import sys
from collections import defaultdict

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, index):
        self.index = index
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def createTree(parent, N):
    nodes = [TreeNode(i) for i in range(N)]
    children = defaultdict(list)

    for i in range(N):
        p = parent[i]
        if p != -1:
            children[p].append(i)

    root_index = parent.index(-1)
    root = nodes[root_index]

    for p in range(N):
        if p in children:
            child_indices = children[p]
            if len(child_indices) >= 1:
                nodes[p].left = nodes[child_indices[0]]
            if len(child_indices) >= 2:
                nodes[p].right = nodes[child_indices[1]]

    return root

    ptr += 1
    parent = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr+N]))
